title: DelegationEscalationRequestedPayload
description: Payload of the DelegationEscalationRequested event (Bug 2a). Fired alongside DelegationEnded, in the same transaction, whenever a delegation ends because the delegate was disabled (reason=delegate_disabled) — this service owns no org-structure data, so it escalates to tenant_admin/tenant_owner rather than a supervisor/team-lead concept it doesn't have. Notify-only: this service never auto-creates a replacement delegation.
